purpose: Run two independent conditional comparisons: a conserved dietary purine-precursor fate ledger for whole-cell GR-5 interception, and a non-conserved endogenous luminal-urate capture comparison between spatial UOX-to-PDB staging and overlapping access. The model does not test joint three-stage complementarity or serum-urate efficacy.
interpretation_policy: Each four-factor structure has 81 unique grid cells. Fractions of grid cells are design-space occupancy, not biological probabilities. The conserved dietary fate ledger and non-conserved endogenous capture comparison are never combined into a serum-urate effect.
